definitions.name: R1C.ABS
definitions.note: Element-wise absolute value of a Vector, as the larger of x and -x.

definitions.name: R1C.CAPWORD
definitions.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT C 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN
definitions.note: Upper-cases the first character of a String and keeps the rest unchanged.

solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V X1.FIROSO 'M' BIND V M SUB R1C.ABS X1.FIROSO
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.series.trimmed: SORT 'S' BIND S 1 DROP -1 DROP X1.GISUZU
solutions.prose.longest: X1.VIDIKO 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP X1.PIMAPA GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: X1.VIDIKO [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.ledger.debtors: X1.RIVINO 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E [ 1 GET ] MAP X1.PIMAPA GET
